policies: If we Cancel: We closely monitor weather conditions, passenger counts, and other factors to ensure the safety and quality of every cruise.
In the event of a cancellation, you may reschedule for another date or receive a full refund if rescheduling is not possible.
Light rain will not cancel a cruise, as our catamaran is 75% covered.
Weather: We will monitor the weather in the days leading up to your trip.
The deposit will be non-refundable if you cancel within 30 days of your scheduled charter.
